name: 华为Java增强编程规则集
nameEn: Huawei Java Enhanced Coding Standard Rule Set
comments: 增强的华为编码规范规则集
commentsEn: Enhancement rule suite for Huawei Coding Standard
creator: system

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.07 A maximum of 5 exceptions can be thrown by one method. Record exceptions and their conditions in the @throws annotation of Javadoc
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.07 一个方法不应抛出超过5个异常，并在Javadoc的@throws标签中记录每个抛出的异常及其条件

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.01 Avoid synchronization pitfalls when implementing synchronization control on shared variables
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.01 对共享变量做同步访问控制时需避开同步陷阱

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.02 Local variables are declared close to the line where they are first used
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.02 局部变量被声明在接近它们首次使用的行

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.07 Release resources in try-with-resource or finally during I/O operations
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.07 进行IO类操作时，必须在try-with-resource或finally里关闭资源

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.07 When child classes override methods of parent classes or implement interfaces
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.07 子类覆写父类方法或实现接口时必须加上@Override注解

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.08 Use Locale.ROOT or Locale.ENGLISH for conversion between uppercase and lowercase strings and formatting to Western Arabic numerals
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.08 字符串大小写转换、数字格式化为西方数字时，必须加上Locale.ROOT或Locale.ENGLISH

ruleInfos.name: G.SEC.04 Protect sensitive operations by a security manager
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SEC.04 使用安全管理器来保护敏感操作

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.06 Do not use asserts in code
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.06 代码中不应使用断言（assert）

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.04 Avoid generating serial numbers of enumeration constants based on the ordinal() method
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.04 避免枚举常量序号的产生依赖于ordinal()方法

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.08 Do not use active GC (unless in password and RMI)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.08 禁止使用主动GC（除非在密码、RMI等方面），尤其是在频繁/周期性的逻辑中

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.05 Avoid overloading of primitive types and their boxed primitives
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.05 避免基本类型与其包装类型的同名重载方法

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.07 Do not hardcode the characters that indicate new lines and file path separators--hard-code line break
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.07 避免在代码中硬编码用于表示换行、文件路径分隔的字符--不要在代码中硬编码用于表示换行字符

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.09 Do not call System.exit() to terminate the JVM
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.09 不要调用System.exit()终止JVM

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.01 An identifier must contain a maximum of 64 characters, including letters, digits, and underscores (_)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.01 标识符应由不超过64字符的字母、数字和下划线组成

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.09 Do not use the Finalizer mechanism.
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.09 禁止使用Finalizer机制

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.08 Boolean variables should start with auxiliary verbs
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.08 布尔型变量建议以表达是非意义的动词开头

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.01 Source files (including comments) should be encoded in UTF-8 format
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.01 源文件编码格式（包括注释）应该是UTF-8

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.10 A thread should be interrupted by service code. Exercise caution when using the Thread.interrupt method
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.10 线程中断由业务代码来协作完成，慎用Thread.interrupt方法

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.08 Do not use return, break, or continue, or throw an exception to abruptly terminate the finally block--Throw from finally block
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.08 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束--在finally块中使用throw语句

ruleInfos.name: G.EDV.06 Prevent XML Entity Expansion (XEE) attacks caused by parsing external XML
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EDV.06 防止解析来自外部的XML导致的内部实体扩展（XML Entity Expansion）攻击

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.04 Do not precompile regexes repeatedly
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.04 不要对正则表达式进行频繁重复预编译

ruleInfos.name: G.MET.01 Methods should be short--code block nesting layers less than 4
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.01 方法要简短--方法的代码块嵌套深度不应超过4层

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.03 Do not use floating-point numbers as loop counters
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.03 禁止使用浮点数作为循环计数器

ruleInfos.name: G.COL.04 Do not modify the collection by performing remove() / add() on elements in a foreach loop
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.COL.04 不要在foreach循环中通过remove()/add()方法更改集合

ruleInfos.name: G.EDV.05 Prevent XML External Entity (XXE) attacks caused by parsing external XML
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EDV.05 防止解析来自外部的XML导致的外部实体（XML External Entity）攻击

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.02 Use System.arraycopy() or Arrays.copyOf() to copy arrays
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.02 使用System.arraycopy()或Arrays.copyOf()进行数组复制

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.03 Use the same type for the second and third operands in the ?: conditional expression
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.03 条件表达式?:的第2和第3个操作数应使用相同的类型

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.04 Use BigDecimal instead of float or double when precise calculation is required
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.04 需要精确计算时使用BigDecimal，不要使用float和double

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.02 Do not call methods that may be overridden by child classes in constructors of parent classes
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.02 不要在父类的构造方法中调用可能被子类覆写的方法

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.08 Do not use return, break, or continue, or throw an exception to abruptly terminate the finally block--Return from finally block
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.08 不要使用return、break、continue或抛出异常使finally块非正常结束--在finally块中使用return语句

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--insecure AES mode
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--AES使用不安全的ECB操作模式

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.01 Use the Collection<T>.toArray(T[]) method to convert collections into arrays (use Collection<T>.toArray(IntFunction<T[]>) for Java 11 and later versions)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.01 将集合转为数组时使用Collection<T>.toArray(T[])方法；Java 11后使用Collection<T>.toArray(IntFunction<T[]>)

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.03 A switch statement must have a default branch
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.03 switch语句要有default分支

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.06 Do not compare against NaN. Use the isNaN() method of the Double or Float class to determine whether the value is NaN
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.06 禁止尝试与NaN进行比较运算，相等操作使用Double或Float的isNaN()方法

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.01 Do not assign values or conduct complex condition judgment in controlling conditional expressions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.01 不要在控制性条件表达式中执行赋值操作或执行复杂的条件判断

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.16 If 'break' is not added to the end of the case statement block, comments should be provided (fall-through)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.16 case语句块结束时如果不加break，需要有注释说明(fall-through)

ruleInfos.name: G.SEC.01 Declare the security check method private or final
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SEC.01 进行安全检查的方法必须声明为private或final

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.05 File header comments should contain the copyright notice
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.05 文件头注释应该包含版权许可信息

ruleInfos.name: G.TYP.05 Do not directly use == to determine the equivalence of floating point data. Do not use equals() or flt.compareTo(another) == 0 to compare floating-point boxed primitives
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.TYP.05 浮点型数据判断相等不要直接使用==，浮点型包装类型不要用equals()或者 flt.compareTo(another) == 0作相等的比较

ruleInfos.name: G.CTL.02 An else branch should be added at the end of the else if statement
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CTL.02 含else if分支的条件判断应在最后加一个else分支

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.02 A source file contains the copyright notice, package, import, and top-level class in sequence, which are separated by blank lines
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.02 一个源文件按顺序包含版权、package、import、顶层类，且用空行分隔

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--RSA without padding
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--RSA未使用填充模式

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.15 Separate enumeration constants by commas (,), with or without line breaks
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.15 枚举常量间用逗号隔开， 换行可选

ruleInfos.name: G.DCL.05 Do not declare mutable objects as public static final
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.DCL.05 禁止将mutable对象声明为public static final

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.04 Declarations of a class or interface should appear in the sequence of class variables, static initialization blocks, instance variables, instance initialization blocks, constructors, and methods, and separated by blank lines
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.04 一个类或接口的声明部分应该按照类变量、静态初始化块、实例变量、实例初始化块、构造器、方法的顺序出现，且用空行分隔

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--key length is less than the specified length
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--密钥长度少于指定长度

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.03 The Javadoc for methods should contain function descriptions. Use @param, @return, and @throws in sequence to add comments for parameters, return values, and exceptions if necessary--There should be a blank line between the function description and the label
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.03 方法的Javadoc中应该包含功能说明，根据实际需要按顺序使用@param、@return、@throws标签对参数、返回值、异常进行注释--功能描述和标签之间要有一个空行

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.14 Redundant spaces should not be inserted for vertical alignment
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.14 不应插入多余空格使代码垂直对齐

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.01 Do not assign the same variable more than once in one expression
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.01 不要在单个表达式中对相同的变量赋值超过一次

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.06 There should be a blank line or space between the comment and the code, and a space between the comment character and the comment content
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.06 注释与代码之间应该有空行或空格，注释符与注释内容之间应该有空格

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--weak encryption algorithms
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--弱加密算法

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.05 Do not use a null in any case where an object is required to prevent null pointer reference
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.05 禁止直接使用可能为null的对象，防止出现空指针引用

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.13 Use spaces to highlight keywords and important information
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.13 用空格突出关键字和重要信息

ruleInfos.name: G.FIO.02 Perform security check when decompressing a ZIP archive using ZipInputStream
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FIO.02 从ZipInputStream中解压文件必须进行安全检查

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.07 No TODO/FIXME comments should be contained in the code delivered to customers
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.07 正式交付给客户的代码不应包含TODO/FIXME注释

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.3 Use hash algorithm with salted value to store passwords safely--salt hardcoded
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.3 基于哈希算法的口令安全存储必须加入盐值（salt）--盐值硬编码

ruleInfos.name: G.ERR.04 Prevent sensitive information leakage caused by exceptions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.ERR.04 防止通过异常泄露敏感信息

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.12 Reduce unnecessary blank lines to keep the code compact
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.12 减少不必要的空行，保持代码紧凑

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.04 When comparing expressions--expression left side tends to change and the right side tends to remain unchanged
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.04 表达式的比较，应该遵循左侧倾向于变化、右侧倾向于不变的原则--表达式比较左变右不变

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.03 Delete unused code segments instead of commenting them out--remove unused code lines
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.03 不用的代码段包括import，直接删除，不要注释掉--不用的代码段，直接删除，不要注释掉

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.3 Use hash algorithm with salted value to store passwords safely--hash iteration count
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.3 基于哈希算法的口令安全存储必须加入盐值（salt）--Hash迭代不充分

ruleInfos.name: Unsafe TLS protocol
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则2.6.1 禁止使用SSL2.0、SSL3.0、TLS1.0、TLS1.1协议

ruleInfos.name: G.EXP.02 Use parentheses to specify the operation sequence of expressions, thereby avoiding excessive dependence on the default priority
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EXP.02 用括号明确表达式的操作顺序，避免过分依赖默认优先级

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.03 Delete unused code segments instead of commenting them out--remove unused import
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.03 不用的代码段包括import，直接删除，不要注释掉--不用的import语句，直接删除，不要注释掉

ruleInfos.name: Rule-9.2 Do not use private or weak encrption algorithms--insecure hash algorithms
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则-9.2 禁止使用私有或者弱加密算法--不安全的哈希算法

ruleInfos.name: Android:Pass Explicit Intents to PendingIntent
ruleInfos.nameCn: 规则6.3 使用PENDINGINTENT触发事件时须传入显式INTENT

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.11 Line feeds should be placed before operators
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.11 建议换行起点在操作符之前

ruleInfos.name: G.SER.01 Do not implement the Serializable interface if possible
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SER.01 尽量避免实现Serializable接口

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.04 Do not write empty-content method header comments
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.04 不写空有格式的方法头注释

ruleInfos.name: G.FIO.03 Use return values of the int type for methods that read a character or byte from a stream
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FIO.03 对于从流中读取一个字符或字节的方法，使用int类型的返回值

ruleInfos.name: Weak encryption inadquate length for HMAC256
ruleInfos.nameCn: 建议2.6.5 SSH协议优先选择ECC密钥交换算法和身份认证公钥算法，优先选择HMAC-SHA2消息认证算法

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.10 Each line contains a maximum of 120 narrow characters
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.10 行宽不超过120个窄字符

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.02 The Javadoc of the top-level public class should contain the function description and creation date/version information
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.02 顶层public类的Javadoc应该包含功能说明和创建日期/版本信息

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.01 Use cryptographically secure random numbers in security scenarios
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.01 安全场景下必须使用密码学意义上的安全随机数

ruleInfos.name: Improper HTTPS cookie secure attribute
ruleInfos.nameCn: 建议5.5 为cookie设置secure标志

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.09 Each line contains one statement only
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.09 每行不超过一个语句

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.12 Use a thread pool to control resources and to prevent excessive creation of new threads
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.12 避免不加控制地创建新线程，应该使用线程池来管控资源

ruleInfos.name: G.SER.04 Do not directly serialize information pointing to system resources
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SER.04 禁止直接序列化指向系统资源的信息

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.01 Avoid synchronization pitfalls when implementing synchronization control on shared variables--Forbid instance lock share static data
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.01 对共享变量做同步访问控制时需避开同步陷阱--不要使用实例锁来保护静态共享数据

ruleInfos.name: G.EDV.04 Do not directly use external data to concatenate XML
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EDV.04 禁止直接使用外部数据来拼接XML

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.07 Avoid empty blocks
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.07 应该避免空块，必须使用空块时，应采用统一的大括号换行风格

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.08 Use the setUncaughtExceptionHandler() method of the thread object to register handlers of uncaught exceptions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.08 使用Thread对象的setUncaughtExceptionHandler方法注册未捕获异常处理者

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.01 Javadoc comments should be present for every public or protected element
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.01 public或protected修饰的元素应添加Javadoc注释

ruleInfos.name: G.OTH.04 Do not include public network addresses in code
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OTH.04 禁止代码中包含公网地址

ruleInfos.name: G.EDV.02 Do not use external data to construct format strings
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EDV.02 禁止直接使用外部数据构造格式化字符串

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.08 Use spaces to indent
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.08 使用空格进行缩进，每次缩进4个空格

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.06 Use new concurrency utilities to replace wait() and notify()
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.06 使用新并发工具代替wait()和notify()

ruleInfos.name: G.CMT.03 The Javadoc for methods should contain function descriptions. Use @param, @return, and @throws in sequence to add comments for parameters, return values, and exceptions if necessary
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CMT.03 方法的Javadoc中应该包含功能说明，根据实际需要按顺序使用@param、@return、@throws标签对参数、返回值、异常进行注释

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.13 Clear custom ThreadLocal variables when the thread in the thread pool ends
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.13 线程池中的任务结束后必须清理其自定义的ThreadLocal变量

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.06 For a non-empty block structure, the opening brace should be placed at the end of a line, and the closing brace should be placed in a new line
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.06 对于非空块状结构，左大括号应该放在行尾，右大括号应该另起一行

ruleInfos.name: G.CON.07 Name a thread when creating it
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.CON.07 创建新线程时必须指定线程名

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.06 Name variables in lowerCamelCase style
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.06 变量采用小驼峰命名

ruleInfos.name: G.FIO.01 Validate and canonicalize path names constructed using external data
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FIO.01 使用外部数据构造的文件路径前必须进行校验，校验前必须对文件路径进行规范化处理

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.05 Braces should be used in conditional statements and loop blocks
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.05 在条件语句和循环块中应该使用大括号

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.10 Remove redundant modifiers from interface definitions
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.10 接口定义中去掉多余的修饰词

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.07 Avoid using Boolean variable names with negative meanings
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.07 避免使用具有否定含义布尔变量名

ruleInfos.name: G.FIO.04 Do not let external processes block on input and output streams
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FIO.04 防止外部进程阻塞在输入输出流上

ruleInfos.name: P.05 Validate external data before using it--Trust boundary violation
ruleInfos.nameCn: P.05 外部数据使用前必须进行合法性校验--信任边界场景

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.20 A proper suffix should be set for the numeric literal, and the long type should use L as the suffix
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.20 数字字面量应该设置合适的后缀，long类型应该使用L作为后缀

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.08 Correctly implement the singleton pattern
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.08 正确实现单例模式

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.05 Capitalize a constant name, with each word separated by an underscore (_)
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.05 常量名采用全大写单词，单词间以下划线分隔

ruleInfos.name: G.SEC.02 Configure a custom class loader to invoke the getPermission() method of the parent class before overriding a getPermission() method
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SEC.02 自定义类加载器覆写getPermission() 时，必须先调用父类的getPermission() 方法

ruleInfos.name: G.EDV.01 Do not directly use external data to concatenate SQL statements
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.EDV.01 禁止直接使用外部数据来拼接SQL语句

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.19 Class and member modifiers (if present) appear in the order recommended by the Java specification
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.19 类和成员修饰符（如果存在）按Java语言规范建议的顺序显示

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.09 Use class names instead of instances or expressions to call static methods
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.09 使用类名调用静态方法，而不要使用实例或表达式来调用

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.04 Methods should be named in lowerCamelCase style
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.04 方法名应采用小驼峰命名

ruleInfos.name: G.SER.07 Prevent deserialization from being used to bypass security operations
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.SER.07 防止反序列化被利用来绕过构造方法中的安全操作

ruleInfos.name: G.PRM.07 Release resources in try-with-resource or finally during I/O operations
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.07 进行IO类操作时，必须在try-with-resource或finally里关闭资源

ruleInfos.name: G.FMT.18 Block comments should be indented to the same level as the code they describe
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.FMT.18 块注释的缩进级别应与上下文代码相同

ruleInfos.name: G.OBJ.03 Constructors with more arguments should be reused
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.OBJ.03 构造方法如果有多个，尽量重用

ruleInfos.name: G.NAM.03 Classes, enumerations, and interfaces should be named in UpperCamelCase style
ruleInfos.nameCn: G.NAM.03 类、枚举和接口名应采用大驼峰命名

ruleInfos.nameCn: G.MET.01 方法要简短--方法行数不应超过50行

ruleInfos.nameCn: G.PRM.10 不要创建临时变量作为return语句的返回值
